test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A local cinema sells tickets for ₹150 per ticket for youth and ₹250 per ticket for adults. One evening, the theater sold a total of 200 tickets and earned ₹38,000. Find the number of youth tickets and adult tickets sold?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all 200 are youth ⇒ 200 × 150 = 30000

Extra needed = 38000 − 30000 = 8000

Each adult adds extra 100

Adults = 8000 ÷ 100 = 80 ⇒ Youth = 120

**∴ Answer = Youth = 120, Adults = 80**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total tickets = 200

Price of youth ticket = 150

Price of adult ticket = 250

Total earning = 38000

**Formula used:**

Linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let youth tickets = x and adult tickets = y

⇒ x + y = 200 ...(1)

⇒ 150x + 250y = 38000 ...(2)

⇒ Divide (2) by 50

⇒ 3x + 5y = 760 ...(3)

⇒ From (1): x = 200 − y

⇒ Substitute in (3)

⇒ 3(200 − y) + 5y = 760

⇒ 600 − 3y + 5y = 760

⇒ 600 + 2y = 760

⇒ 2y = 160

⇒ y = 80

⇒ x = 200 − 80 = 120

**∴ The correct answer is Youth = 120, Adults = 80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumption Method

Assume all items of one type, then adjust using difference

Linear Equations

Form equations using total and value

Difference Concept

Extra value per unit helps find quantity quickly
